title: The project showcase got a thorough cleanup
summary:
The community project garden grew a few new apps and got its paths cleared: better listings, fewer dead links, and more useful setup docs.

Across the week, project listings were corrected, outdated entries and dead links were removed, and the README and project tables were refreshed. toai.chat now has the right author credit, repository, and description without an invalid website link; Anime Character Generator points to its working app page. Link-checking scripts were organized to make the next round of gardening easier.

VOID.AI joined the chat projects list as an AI mentor for coding, writing, and everyday questions. AIStorium and AI Word Search joined Games, while Prompt Explorer joined Learn. Refreshed tables also surfaced PairFusion and CraftUI.

The README gained an example for launching the Pollinations MCP server from a client with npx, and the Open Web UI tutorial link was updated to the current guide. The MCP section still has a Markdown fence to fix.
